profiles.label: Broader search
profiles.description: Include more possible moments for review. Analysis takes longer and can flag irrelevant objects.

profiles.label: Fast search
profiles.description: Purpose-trained compact detector (YOLOX-tiny). About a second per clip on CPU and few false candidates, but it can miss some interactions; review the original footage.

profiles.label: Stricter search
profiles.description: Filter out lower-confidence detections. This can miss visible interactions; review the original footage.
